description: This PHP source file defines the AuthValidateController class, which handles authentication validation requests within the OrangeHRM testing framework. It manages user credentials, invokes authentication services, and generates JSON responses indicating authentication success.

classes.name: AuthValidateController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling authentication validation, extending AbstractController, implementing PublicControllerInterface, and using AuthUserTrait to manage user authentication status.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the AuthenticationService instance used for user credential validation.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming authentication validation requests, retrieves credentials from the request, performs authentication, updates user authentication status, and returns a JSON response indicating whether authentication was successful.
